name: Repeating hand crossbow
source: Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 33, Ultimate Equipment pg. 21
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 33, Ultimate Equipment pg. 21
Statistics
Cost 800 gp Weight 4 lbs.
Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical 19-20/x2; Range 30 ft.; Type P; Special —
Category Ranged; Proficiency Exotic
Weapon Groups Crossbows
Description
This weapon functions identically to a repeating heavy crossbow, except its damage, critical, and range values are equivalent to those of a hand crossbow instead.
